correctness.rationale: Twelve antipodal representatives give Gram entries with just three signed off-diagonal cosines in Q(√2). The frozen checker explicitly constructs the integer relation matrices, their independent 1+2+3+6 sectors, and verifies the quadratic minimal-polynomial identity in independent u,v,w using ten unisolvent evaluations. Its exact Q(√2) recurrence and sign tests cover degrees 0..199, proving the isolated degree-nine two-dimensional null sector, positivity otherwise, and the exact k14 extreme eigenvalues L,U. For all k≥200, Bernstein–Szegő and |dot|<3/4 give Gershgorin lower bound >1/50, controlling rank and condition number; finite exact bounds separate k13 and k14 and show all other full-rank degrees have κ<3600. Independent floating numerical Gram ranks 0..15 and k14 tiny eigenvalue ≈1.63924×10^-5 match, but are only corroboration.
